items.title: Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent
items.summary: Zelensky says Kyiv would support such a truce. Moscow has yet to comment.

items.title: Saudi capital airport hit by second Houthi strike in two days
items.summary: The Yemeni group says it carried out attacks that killed 13 people in Riyadh over the weekend and targeted two airports and oil facilities.

items.title: PM says it is 'clear' Russia interfered with Brexit vote
items.summary: He says voters were not "sufficiently" informed about how foreign actors sought to disrupt UK democracy.

items.title: Wildlife park remains closed after fatal tiger attack
items.summary: Yorkshire Wildlife Park remains closed after a man entered the tiger enclosure and was fatally attacked on Saturday.

items.title: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk
items.summary: Police received credible information about possible attacks against Donald Tusk and his defence minister.

items.title: DUP MP says her party could help remove O'Neill as first minister over Drumcree row
items.summary: Carla Lockhart says unionist voters are angry at Michelle O'Neill over her role in the Garvaghy Road protests.

items.title: Orangutans released back into Borneo forest after devastating fires
items.summary: Rescuers moved the apes after their habitats were threatened by intense wildfires over the summer.

items.title: Children among 139 dead after boat capsizes off Djibouti, UN says
items.summary: The boat was travelling from Djibouti to Yemen with 305 people on board, when it capsized near the port town of Obock on Thursday night.
